blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Infrared--visible (IR--VIS) multi-modal perception supports robust scene understanding under challenging illumination. Infrared and visible images are often misaligned due to platform motion, viewpoint changes, and modality-dependent distortions, causing registration errors to propagate into subsequent fusion and detection stages. We propose TriDifNet, a unified three-task diffusion network for end-to-end RGB-T perception. To the best of our knowledge, TriDifNet is the first diffusion-based network that jointly optimizes registration, fusion, and detection for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception. TriDifNet consists of three diffusion-based modules, i.e., the Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM), the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM), and the Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM). RegDM aligns the unaligned infrared image to the optical reference by estimating a dense deformation field. FusDM performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation with optical structural cues and complementary infrared saliency. DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. To couple the three tasks, TriDifNet introduces a closed-loop optimization mechanism, where detection semantics guide fusion and registration, and the fusion result further regularizes geometric alignment. A stage-wise progressive training strategy and a lightweight Nash multi-task learning (Nash-MTL)-based late-stage refinement are further adopted to balance registration, fusion, and detection optimization. Extensive experiments on the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark show that TriDifNet achieves superior downstream detection performance under misaligned RGB-T settings. Against strong system-level competitors, TriDifNet achieves 65.44\% Recall, 57.55\% mAP$_{50}$, and 26.83\% mAP$_{50:95}$.
blocks.zh: 红外可见(IR-VIS)多模式感应支持在有挑战性的照明下进行强力场景理解. 红外线和可见图像往往由于平台运动,观点变化和模式依赖的扭曲而错位相通,导致注册错误被传播到随后的聚变和检测阶段. 我们提议TriDifNet,一个统一的三任务传播网络,用于端到端的RGB-T感知. TriDifNet是第一个基于传播的网络, TriDifNet由三个以扩散为基础的模块组成,即注册分化模块(RegDM),融合分化模块(FusDM)和检测分化模块(DetDM). RegDM通过估计一个密集的变形场来将不相通的红外图像与光学参考物相配合. FusDM进行残留的有条件扩散,以产生以探测为导向并带有光学结构提示和互补的红外光光亮度的引信表示. DetDM在边框空间中将行人检测设定为迭代去名过程. 为了对接这三项任务,TriDifNet引入了闭路优化机制,其中检测语义指导聚变和注册,聚变结果进一步将几何对接规范化. 进一步采用分阶段渐进式培训战略和以纳什为主的轻量级多任务学习(Nash-MTL)后期改进,以平衡登记、聚变和检测优化。 对KAIST多光谱行人基准的广泛实验表明,TriDifNet在RGB-T错配的设置下实现了优异下游检测性能. 对抗强大的系统级竞争者, TriDifNet实现65.44\% 召回,57.55美元/50美元/和26.83美元/50:95美元。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Infrared–visible(IR–VIS) multi-modal perception has become increasingly important in safety-critical scenarios such as night-time surveillance, autonomous driving, and search-and-rescue. Visible images provide rich texture and structural details, whereas infrared imagery highlights thermal saliency and remains robust under adverse illumination. In practice, however, the two modalities are often spatially misaligned due to platform motion, viewpoint variation, capture timing differences, and modality-dependent imaging distortions. The core challenge is therefore not merely the presence of cross-modal misalignment itself, but the fact that geometric alignment, cross-modal fusion, and task-level semantics are usually optimized in a decoupled manner. Recent studies have shown that registration and fusion should not be treated as entirely independent stages [ 1 ] , and that bidirectional interaction between them can improve both alignment quality and fusion fidelity [ 2 ] . More recent efforts have further explored tighter registration–fusion integration within unified or single-stage methods [ 3 , 4 ] . For example, IMF introduces a one-stage progressive dense registration scheme and jointly optimizes it with a Transformer–Conv fusion subnetwork to mitigate structural distortions and edge ghosts in misaligned infrared–visible fusion [ 4 ] . Nevertheless, object detection in most existing registration–fusion systems still remains an external downstream consumer of the fused result rather than an endogenous optimization target inside the perception loop.
blocks.zh: 在诸如夜间监视、自主驾驶和搜救等安全关键情况下,红外-可见(IR-VIS)多式联运观念已变得越来越重要。 可见的图像提供了丰富的纹理和结构细节,而红外线图像则突出热亮度,并在不利的照明下保持坚固. 然而在实践中,由于平台运动,观点变异,捕捉时间差异,以及模式依赖的成像扭曲,这两种模式往往在空间上错位. 因此,核心挑战不仅仅是跨模式错位本身的存在,而是几何对齐,跨模式聚变,和任务级语义通常以脱钩的方式优化. 最近的研究表明,登记和核聚变不应被视为完全独立的阶段[1],它们之间的双向互动可以提高配对质量和核聚变忠心性[2]。 最近的努力进一步探索了在统一或单一阶段方法内更严格地进行登记-整合[3、4]。 例如,IMF引入了一个单阶段渐进密集的注册计划,并用变形器-Conv聚变子网络共同优化它,以减少结构扭曲和边缘幽灵在误联红外线-可见聚变 [4] 。 然而,大多数现有登记-聚变系统中的物体检测仍然是引信结果的外部下游消费者,而不是感知圈内的内源性优化目标。

blocks.en: A representative limitation appears in conventional sequential pipelines that perform registration first and fusion afterward. In such methods, registration is optimized before knowing which structures and regions are truly critical for downstream recognition, while fusion is forced to absorb the residual errors inherited from upstream geometric inaccuracies. This issue becomes more severe in practical misaligned IR–VIS scenarios, where explicit alignment is difficult [ 5 ] and cross-modal appearance discrepancy is large [ 6 ] . As a result, even mild misregistration can cause ghosting, double edges, structural distortion, or target deformation in the fused result [ 7 , 4 ] . In complex real-world sensing conditions, such sensitivity to misalignment can further degrade the effectiveness of subsequent fusion-based perception [ 8 ] . Consequently, the fusion stage is often reduced to a compensatory process on imperfectly aligned inputs, which limits both semantic fidelity and downstream robustness.
blocks.zh: 代表性限制出现在先进行登记然后进行核聚变的常规顺序管道中。 在这种方法中,在知道哪些结构和区域对下游识别真正至关重要之前,对登记进行了优化,而聚变则被迫吸收上游几何不准确而遗留下来的剩余错误。 这个问题在实际错误的IR-VIS情景中变得更加严重,在这种情景中,明确一致很难[5],跨模式外观差异很大[6]。 因此,即使是轻度的误登记也会在引信结果中引起幽灵,双边,结构扭曲,或目标变形[7,4]. 在复杂的现实世界感知条件下,这种对错配的敏感性会进一步降低后续聚变感知的有效性[8]. 因此,聚变阶段往往被缩小为对不完全一致的投入进行补偿的过程,这既限制了语义上的忠诚,也限制了下游的稳健性。

blocks.en: Another line of work attempts to inject high-level semantics into fusion, for example by using segmentation or detection signals to guide the generation of fused representations [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Recent VIS–IR detection-oriented fusion methods further show that fusion and detection should be optimized in a task-consistent manner. For instance, MMI-Det explores multi-level visible–infrared integration with contour enhancement, fusion-focused feature interaction, contrastive bridging, and information-guided optimization to better balance fusion and detection objectives [ 13 ] . EI2Det further introduces cross-modal interaction, illumination-aware modality weighting, and edge-guided fusion to improve detection robustness under varying lighting conditions [ 14 ] . In parallel, recent weakly aligned RGB-T detection studies have recognized that strict cross-modal alignment is often unrealistic in practice [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Uncertainty-aware cross-modal detectors also indicate that practical RGB–IR perception suffers from object-level uncertainty caused by low-light visible observations, confusing infrared responses, thermal ghost shadows, and pose-induced cross-modal misalignment [ 19 ] . Although these efforts demonstrate the value of task semantics, modality reliability, and alignment-aware detection, detection is still commonly treated either as an auxiliary guidance source for fusion or as a separate downstream task. As a result, it is rarely incorporated as a trainable component that jointly shapes alignment, fusion behavior, and final recognition. Consequently, what remains missing is a unified network in which geometric alignment, cross-modal fusion, and task-level detection semantics are optimized within a shared closed loop.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作试图将高级语义注入聚变中,例如通过使用分化或检测信号来引导产生引信表达[9,10,11,12]. 最近的VIS-IR面向检测的聚变方法进一步表明,核聚变和检测应当以符合任务的方式优化. 例如,MMI-Det探索多层次的可见-红外融合,并伴有轮廓增强、聚变重点特征互动、对比性桥梁以及信息引导优化,以便更好地平衡聚变和检测目标[13]。 环境信息2 Det进一步引入了跨模式交互,发光感知模式加权,以及边缘导体聚变,以提高不同照明条件下的探测强度[14]. 与此同时,最近对RGB-T的检测研究也认识到,严格的跨模式对接在实践中往往不现实[15、16、17、18]。 不确定-认知的跨模式探测器也表明,实际的RGB-IR感知因低光可见观测,混淆红外响应,热鬼阴影,以及姿势引发的跨模式错配[19]而导致的物体级不确定性. 虽然这些努力证明了任务语义,方式可靠性和对齐感知检测的价值,但检测仍然被普遍视为聚变的辅助导源或单独的下游任务. 因此,它很少被集成为可训练组件,共同塑造对齐,聚变行为,以及最终识别. 因此,还缺少一个统一的网络,在这个网络中,在共享的闭路圈内优化几何对齐、跨模式聚变和任务级检测语义。

blocks.en:
Recently, diffusion models have demonstrated strong capacity for high-fidelity generation and restoration [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] , making them appealing for misaligned IR–VIS perception.
More importantly, diffusion provides a unified iterative refinement view for the three tasks considered in this work.
For registration, cross-modal matching under weak affine misalignment still involves spatially varying deformation estimation, which can be naturally cast as a progressive denoising process over deformation fields [ 24 , 2 ] .
For fusion, the optical image already provides a stable structural base, while the complementary infrared contribution is better modeled as a conditional residual restoration problem rather than direct full-image generation [ 25 , 26 ] .
For detection, object localization can be reformulated as iterative denoising in the bounding-box space, enabling progressive refinement from noisy box hypotheses to final object predictions [ 27 ] .
Therefore, instead of treating registration, fusion, and detection as heterogeneous modules coupled only at the loss level, diffusion offers a common optimization perspective in which geometry, cross-modal representation, and task semantics can all be refined through task-specific denoising processes.
This shared formulation is particularly suitable for the proposed closed-loop design, as it makes the three tasks not only jointly trainable, but also conceptually unified under iterative error correction and mutual refinement.
blocks.zh:
最近,传播模式显示出高可靠性生成和恢复[20, 21, 22, 23]的强大能力,使它们呼吁对IR-VIS概念的误解。
更重要的是,传播为这项工作中考虑的三项任务提供了统一的迭代完善观点。
就登记而言,在微弱的afine错配下进行跨模式匹配仍然涉及空间变化的变形估计,这种估计可以自然地被证明是相对于变形场的渐进变形过程[24,2].
对于聚变来说,光学图像已经提供了稳定的结构基础,而互补的红外作用被更好的模型化为有条件的残余恢复问题,而不是直接的全图像生成[25,26].
对于探测,可以将物体本地化重塑为在边框空间中的迭代去诺,从而能够从吵闹的盒子假设逐渐完善到最终的物体预测[27].
因此,扩散不是将登记、聚变和检测作为不同的模块,只在损失一级进行组合,而是提供了一个共同的优化视角,在这种视角中,几何、跨模式表述和任务语义都可以通过特定任务的去名过程加以完善。
这种共享的配方特别适合拟议的闭路设计,因为它使这三项任务不仅可以共同训练,而且在迭代错误校正和相互完善下在概念上统一.

blocks.en: Building on this unified denoising perspective, we propose TriDifNet, a unified three-task diffusion network that jointly optimizes registration, fusion, and detection in an end-to-end manner . Instead of following the conventional “registration → \rightarrow fusion → \rightarrow detection” chain, TriDifNet explicitly couples the three tasks within one optimization system. First, a Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM) performs conditional diffusion to estimate a dense deformation field and warp the unaligned infrared image toward the optical reference. Then, a Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM) performs residual conditional diffusion under the joint guidance of the optical image and the registered infrared image. This residual parameterization is adopted since the optical image already provides a stable structural base, while the diffusion model only needs to generate the complementary cross-modal component that injects infrared saliency into target-relevant regions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TriDifNet这个统一的三任务传播网络, TriDifNet没有遵循常规的“登记-右倾聚变-右倾检测”链条,而是在一个优化系统中明确将三项任务相配。 首先,一个登记扩散模块(RegDM)进行有条件的扩散,以估计一个密集的变形场,并将不相通的红外线图像向光学参照物倾斜。 然后,一个聚变扩散模块(FusDM)在光学图像和注册红外图像的共同指导下进行剩余有条件的传播. 这种剩余参数化之所以被采用,是因为光学图像已经提供了稳定的结构基础,而扩散模型只需要产生互补的跨模式组件,将红外光光学引向目标相关区域。

blocks.en:
To prevent detection from remaining a detached downstream head, we further elevate it into a trainable third task through a Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM), which formulates object detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. DetDM operates on the detection-oriented fusion representation and produces the final pedestrian predictions, while simultaneously feeding task semantics back into the upstream modules. In particular, the fusion branch is constrained by an ROI-guided task-driven supervision, denoted as Det2Fus , so that target-centered regions receive stronger infrared enhancement and more discriminative fusion behavior. In parallel, registration is regularized by infrared-domain object-level semantic consistency between the misaligned and registered infrared images, denoted as Det2Reg . For this purpose, we employ a frozen YOLO detector only during training as a stable infrared-domain semantic anchor, rather than reusing the trainable fusion-side detector. This allows the registration branch to receive consistent object-level supervision without being affected by the optimization drift of the fusion-domain detection process. Finally, the fusion result is also fed back to regularize registration through a structural fusion-to-registration constraint, denoted as Fus2Reg , forming a closed-loop optimization over the three tasks.
To stabilize optimization across the three branches, TriDifNet
is trained in a stage-wise progressive manner. After full closed-loop
joint training, we further perform a lightweight Nash-MTL-based [ 28 ] late-stage refinement across the registration, fusion, and detection
branches, so that the three task objectives can be dynamically balanced
in the final optimization stage.
blocks.zh:
为了防止检测仍是一个脱落的下游头,我们通过一个检测扩散模块(DetDM)进一步将其提升为可训练的第三项任务,该模块将物体检测作为边框空间的迭代除诺过程。 DetDM运行于检测导向的聚变表示,并产生最终行人预测,同时将任务语义反馈回上游模块. 特别是,聚变分支受到ROI引导的任务驱动监督(Det2Fus)的制约,因此以目标为中心的区域得到更强的红外增强和更歧视性的聚变行为. 同时,登记通过红外线域对象层面的语义一致性来规范误联和注册红外线图像,表示为Det2Reg. 为此,我们仅在训练期间使用冷冻的YOLO探测器作为稳定的红外线域语义锚,而不是重新使用可训练的聚变侧探测器. 这使得注册分支在不受聚变域检测过程优化漂移影响的情况下,能够接受一致的物体级监督. 最后,聚变结果也通过结构聚变到登记限制(Fus2Reg)反馈到注册规范化,形成对三项任务的闭路优化.
为了稳定三分支的优化,TriDifNet
以分阶段渐进的方式接受培训。 完全关闭后
联合训练,我们进一步进行基于轻量级纳什-MTL的[28]晚期改进,涵盖登记、核聚变和检测
三个任务目标能够动态平衡
在最后优化阶段。

blocks.en: In this way, TriDifNet is not a simple concatenation of three modules, but a jointly optimized perception network in which geometry, fusion, and semantics are mutually constrained. RegDM improves the geometric basis for both fusion and recognition; FusDM builds a cross-modal representation that is explicitly shaped by downstream task demands; and DetDM not only produces the final predictions but also acts as a semantic driver for upstream learning. Through this closed-loop design, the proposed network reduces early-stage error propagation and promotes coordinated improvement in alignment quality, cross-modal complementarity, and pedestrian detection performance.
blocks.zh: 这样,TriDifNet就不是三个模块的简单组合,而是共同优化的感知网络,其中几何,聚变,语义是相互制约的. RegDM改进了聚变和识别的几何基础;FusDM构建了一种由下游任务需求明确塑造的跨模式代表;DetDM不仅产生最终预测,还起到上游学习的语义驱动作用. 通过这种闭路设计,拟议的网络减少了早期误差传播,并促进协调改进对齐质量、跨模式互补和行人探测性能。

blocks.en:
The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We propose a unified three-task end-to-end network for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception, which jointly optimizes infrared–visible registration, fusion, and detection within a shared closed loop instead of treating them as isolated or sequential stages. • We develop a diffusion-based multi-module formulation for the three tasks, in which RegDM performs conditional deformation estimation for cross-modal alignment, FusDM performs residual conditional diffusion for complementary infrared–visible fusion, and DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. • We design explicit cross-task coupling mechanisms, including Det2Reg for detection-guided registration via a frozen infrared-domain semantic anchor, Det2Fus for ROI-guided task-driven fusion, and Fus2Reg for structural fusion-to-registration feedback, thereby establishing a genuine closed-loop optimization among geometry, fusion, and semantics. • By integrating the above components into TriDifNet and employing a stage-wise training strategy with a lightweight late-stage three-branch Nash-MTL refinement, the proposed method achieves clear end-to-end detection improvements under misaligned RGB-T inputs.
On the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark with controlled RGB-T misalignment, TriDifNet reaches 65.44% Recall, 57.55% mAP 50 , and 26.83% mAP 50:95 .
The results show superior system-level performance against strong competing pipelines under the same setting.
blocks.zh:
这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出一个统一的三任务端对端网络,用于RGB-T行人感知错位,共同优化红外-可见的注册,聚变,并在共享的闭环内检测,而不是把它们作为孤立或相继的阶段对待. ^ 我们为三项任务开发一种基于扩散的多模块配制,其中RegDM对跨模式对齐进行有条件的变形估计,FusDM对互补红外-可见聚变进行剩余有条件的传播,DetDM将行人探测作为边框空间的迭代除号过程. ^ 我们设计明确的跨任务耦合机制,包括Det2Reg用于通过冷冻红外线域语义锚进行探测制导登记,Det2Fus用于ROI导任务驱动聚变,Fus2Reg用于结构聚变对注册反馈,从而在几何、聚变和语义之间建立真正的闭路优化。 通过将上述组件整合到TriDifNet中,并采用具有轻量级后期三分支纳什-MTL改进功能的阶段性培训策略,该拟议方法在RGB-T输入错位下实现了明确的端到端检测改进.
在KAIST多光谱行人基准上,有控制的RGB-T错位,TriDifNet达到65.44%的回调,57.55%的mAP 50,26.83%的mAP 50:95.
结果显示,在同一个环境下,系统一级的业绩优于竞争激烈的管道。

blocks.en: II Brief Introduction to Diffusion Model
blocks.zh: 二. 传播模式简介

blocks.en:
Diffusion models are likelihood-based generative models that learn a data distribution by simulating a gradual noising process and then learning its denoising reverse process [ 29 ] .
This section briefly introduces the standard DDPM formulation, including forward diffusion, reverse diffusion, and conditional diffusion.

blocks.en:
This section describes the architecture and optimization of TriDifNet.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , TriDifNet is organized as a modular closed-loop network, where registration, fusion, and detection are executed sequentially in the forward path and are further coupled through cross-task feedback during training.

blocks.en: TriDifNet consists of three core components: 1. Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM): estimates a dense deformation field to align the unaligned infrared image with the optical reference image, producing the registered infrared input for fusion. 2. Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM): performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation from the optical image and the registered infrared image. 3. Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM): formulates object detection as a denoising diffusion process in bounding-box space and performs ROI-guided re-inference for final prediction.
blocks.zh: TriDifNet包括三个核心组成部分: 1. 登记扩散模块(RegDM):估计一个密集的变形场,以使不相通的红外线图像与光学参考图像一致,产生用于核聚变的注册红外线输入. 2. 聚变扩散模块(FusDM):进行剩余有条件的传播,从光学图像和注册红外图像中产生面向探测的引信表示。 3. 检测扩散模块(DetDM):将物体检测作为定界框空间的消音扩散过程,并进行ROI制导的再推论以进行最后预测。

blocks.zh: 注册扩散模块(RegDM):估算一个密集的变形场,将不相通的红外图像与光学参考图像对齐,产生注册的红外输入用于核聚变.

blocks.en: Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM): performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation from the optical image and the registered infrared image.
blocks.zh: 聚变扩散模块(FusDM):进行剩余有条件的传播,从光学图像和注册红外图像中产生面向探测的引信表示.

blocks.en: Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM): formulates object detection as a denoising diffusion process in bounding-box space and performs ROI-guided re-inference for final prediction.

blocks.en:
The three components are connected by explicit cross-task interactions.
In the forward direction, RegDM provides aligned infrared guidance to FusDM ( Reg-to-Fus ), and FusDM supplies the detector-oriented representation to DetDM ( Fus-to-Det ).
In the feedback direction, the fusion result regularizes registration through structural consistency ( Fus2Reg ), a frozen infrared-domain detector provides semantic supervision for detection-guided registration ( Det2Reg ), and the detector feeds ROI-guided task semantics back to the fusion branch ( Det2Fus ).
Through these interactions, the three tasks are jointly refined within a unified closed-loop network.
blocks.zh:
这三个组件通过明确的跨任务交互连接.
在前进方向,RegDM向FusDM(Reg-to-Fus)提供对齐的红外线指导,FusDM向DetDM(Fus-to-Det)提供面向探测器的表示.
在反馈方向上,聚变结果通过结构一致性(Fus2Reg)使注册规范化,冷冻红外线域探测器为探测制导注册提供语义监督(Det2Reg),探测器反馈ROI制导的任务语义返回聚变分支(Det2Fus).
通过这些互动,三个任务在一个统一的闭合网内共同完善.

blocks.en:
The remainder of this section is organized as follows.
Sec. III-B defines the notation and formulates the three-task problem.
Sec. III-C details the Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM).
Sec. III-D presents the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM).
Sec. III-E introduces the Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM).
Sec. III-F describes the cross-task coupling paths among registration, fusion, and detection.
Sec. III-G presents the stage-wise training strategy and the Nash-MTL-based late-stage refinement.
Finally, Sec. III-H summarizes the inference pipeline.

blocks.en: III-C Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM)
blocks.zh: III-C 登记扩散模块

blocks.en: III-C 1 Conditional Diffusion for Deformation Field Estimation

blocks.en:
The Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM) formulates dense infrared-to-optical alignment as a conditional diffusion denoising process over the inverse deformation field.
Given the optical reference image Y Y and the unaligned infrared image Z ′ Z^{\prime} , RegDM aims to estimate an inverse deformation field that maps the source infrared image into the optical reference coordinate system.

blocks.en: III-D Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM)
blocks.zh: III-D 融合扩散模块

After RegDM produces the registered infrared image Z ^ \hat{Z} , the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM) performs conditional diffusion to generate a cross-modal residual representation under the joint guidance of the optical image and the aligned infrared image.
Unlike direct full-image generation, FusDM adopts a residual formulation since the optical image Y Y already provides a stable structural and textural base, while the fusion branch mainly needs to inject complementary infrared saliency into target-relevant regions.

与直接全成像生成不同,FusDM采用残余配体,因为光学图像Y Y已经提供了稳定的结构基础和纹理基础,而聚变分支主要需要向目标相关区域注入互补的红外光素.

blocks.en: III-E Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM)
blocks.zh: III-E 检测扩散模块

blocks.en: III-E 1 Diffusion-Based Detection Formulation
blocks.zh: III-E 1 基于扩散的检测制剂

blocks.en: To prevent detection from remaining a detached downstream task, TriDifNet introduces a Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM) as the third trainable component in the closed-loop system. Instead of directly predicting object boxes in a one-shot manner, DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in the bounding-box space. Given a detector-oriented fusion representation, the detector starts from a set of noisy box proposals and progressively refines them into the final object predictions.

blocks.en:
Unlike a conventional single-pass detector, the current DetDM does not directly use the first-pass prediction D 3 D_{3} as the final output.
Instead, D 3 D_{3} is converted into an ROI prior and used to refine the detector-side fusion representation for second-pass detection.

blocks.en: III-E 3 Detection Objective
blocks.zh: 检测目标

blocks.en:
The optimization of DetDM consists of two coupled levels.
At the detector level, we adopt the box-space diffusion detection objective to supervise the final second-pass prediction D ^ 3 \hat{D}_{3} : L D = L D cls + L D box + L D giou L_{D}=L_{D}^{\mathrm{cls}}+L_{D}^{\mathrm{box}}+L_{D}^{\mathrm{giou}} (40) where L D cls L_{D}^{\mathrm{cls}} is the classification loss, L D box L_{D}^{\mathrm{box}} is the box regression loss, and L D giou L_{D}^{\mathrm{giou}} is the generalized intersection-over-union loss.
blocks.zh:
DetDM的优化由两个并联的层次组成.
在探测器层面,我们采用箱-空间扩散探测目标,以监督最后的第二次通过预测 D^3\hat{D}_{3}: L D = L D cls + L D box + L D ou L_{D}=D}^{\Mathrm{cls}}+L_{D}^{\Mathrm{box}}+L_{D}^{\Mathrm{giou}}(40),其中L cDlsD_{Mathrm{cls}}是分类损失,LD盒L_{D_{Mathrm{box}}是框回归损失,LD giD_{M}^{\M}^{\Giou}}是通用的交叉联盟损失.

blocks.en:
At the representation level, the detector is further coupled with the fusion branch through ROI-guided task-driven constraints.
These constraints do not merely supervise the final boxes; instead, they act on the detector-oriented fusion representation itself through M mix M_{\mathrm{mix}} and F det td F_{\mathrm{det}}^{\mathrm{td}} .
Consequently, the detector not only predicts pedestrian instances, but also provides semantic feedback that reshapes the fusion-side representation before final inference.
blocks.zh:
在代表层面,探测器通过ROI制导的任务驱动制约与聚变分支进一步结合.
这些限制并不仅仅监督最终的盒子;相反,它们通过M混合M_{\mathrm{mix}和F det f_{\mathrm{det}}^{\mathrm{td}}},在探测器导向的聚变表达方式上发挥作用。
因此,探测器不仅预测行人事件,而且还提供语义反馈,在最后推论前重塑聚变侧面代表.

blocks.en: Therefore, the overall role of DetDM in TriDifNet is twofold: • it serves as the final pedestrian detector operating on fusion-side representations; • it acts as a task-semantic driver that constructs the ROI-guided feedback used by the Det2Fus pathway.
blocks.zh: 因此,DetDM在TriDifNet中的总体作用是双重的: • 它作为最后的行人探测器,在聚变侧表示上运行; • 它作为一个任务语义驱动器,构建Det2Fus路径所使用的ROI制导反馈.

blocks.en: it serves as the final pedestrian detector operating on fusion-side representations;
blocks.zh: 它作为最后的行人探测器,运行在聚变侧面的显示器上;

blocks.en: it acts as a task-semantic driver that constructs the ROI-guided feedback used by the Det2Fus pathway.

blocks.en: In this way, detection is lifted from a passive downstream consumer to an endogenous component of the closed-loop optimization, enabling the final detector to jointly influence fusion behavior and, through the cross-task constraints, the overall RGB-T perception process.
blocks.zh: 这样,检测被从被动的下游消费者提升到闭路优化的内源成分,使最终检测器能够共同影响聚变行为,并通过跨任务限制,整体RGB-T感知过程.

blocks.en: III-F Cross-Task Coupling: Registration–Fusion–Detection
blocks.zh: 三-F 交叉任务:登记-合并-检测

blocks.en:
A key contribution of TriDifNet is to explicitly couple registration, fusion, and detection in a closed-loop manner, so that improvements in one task can directly constrain and enhance the others.
The resulting interactions include a forward coupling from registration to fusion, a semantic feedback path from detection to registration, a task-driven feedback path from detection to fusion, and a structural feedback path from fusion to registration.
These couplings are denoted as Reg-to-Fus , Fus2Reg , Det2Reg , Det2Fus , and Fus-to-Det , respectively.
blocks.zh:
TriDifNet的一项关键贡献是以闭锁方式明确对注册、核聚变和检测进行对等,这样一项任务的改进就可以直接制约和加强另一项任务。
由此产生的相互作用包括:从注册到核聚变的前联,从检测到注册的语义反馈路径,从检测到核聚变的任务驱动反馈路径,以及从核聚变到注册的结构反馈路径.
这些组合分别表示为Reg-to-Fus,Fus2Reg,Det2Reg,Det2Fus,Fus-to-Det.

blocks.en: III-F 1 Registration-to-Fusion Consistency (Reg-to-Fus)
blocks.zh: III-F 1 登记与统一一致性(Reg-to-Fus)

blocks.en:
The registered infrared image Z ^ \hat{Z} produced by RegDM serves as the geometrically aligned infrared condition for FusDM.
By replacing the raw unaligned infrared input with Z ^ \hat{Z} , FusDM operates on a cross-modal pair with substantially reduced spatial discrepancy, which stabilizes the residual diffusion process and improves the structural consistency of the fused output.
Accordingly, Reg-to-Fus is implemented by using Z ^ \hat{Z} as the infrared condition in the FusDM residual diffusion process defined in Sec. III-D .
This forward coupling allows FusDM to operate on a geometrically corrected RGB-T pair and stabilizes the generation of the fused representation.
blocks.zh:
RegDM制作的注册红外图像Z ^\hat{Z}作为FusDM的几何对齐红外条件.
FusDM通过用Z^\hat{Z}取代原生的不对齐红外输入,在大幅缩小空间差异的交叉模式对运行,稳定了剩余扩散过程,提高了被引信输出的结构一致性.
因此,Reg-to-Fus通过使用Z ^\ hat{Z}作为Sec. III-D定义的FusDM残余扩散过程中的红外条件来实现.
这种前置耦合使FusDM能够在几何校正的RGB-T对上运行,稳定了引信代表物的生成.

blocks.en: III-F 2 Fusion-to-Registration Structural Feedback (Fus2Reg)
blocks.zh: 结构反馈(Fus2Reg)

blocks.en:
Beyond serving as the output of FusDM, the fused representation also feeds back to RegDM as a structural regularizer.
The motivation is that the fusion result encodes cross-modal structural consistency after complementary information from both modalities has been integrated, and such fused structural cues can be used to further regularize geometric alignment.
blocks.zh:
除了作为FusDM的输出外,被熔化的表示器还反馈回RegDM作为结构调节器.
其动机是,聚变结果在两种模式的互补信息整合后,编码了跨模式结构一致性,这种被熔化的结构提示可用于进一步规范几何对齐.

blocks.en:

This constraint encourages the registered infrared image to share consistent structural responses with the fusion-enhanced structure, thereby correcting deformation estimation using fusion-driven geometry cues.

blocks.en: III-F 3 Detection-Guided Registration (Det2Reg)
blocks.zh: III-F 3 检测指导登记(Det2Reg)

blocks.en:
Low-level alignment cues alone are insufficient for object-centric RGB-T perception, since registration should also preserve the semantic consistency of target regions across the unaligned and registered infrared domains.
To this end, we introduce Det2Reg , which uses a frozen infrared-domain detector as a stable semantic anchor during training.

仅低级对齐提示不足以使以物体为中心的RGB-T感知,因为登记还应保持未对齐和登记的红外线域目标区域的语义一致性。
为此,我们引入了Det2Reg,在训练时使用冷冻红外线域探测器作为稳定的语义锚.

Unlike using the trainable fusion-side detector, this frozen infrared-domain detector provides a stable semantic reference and avoids introducing optimization drift from the fusion-side detection branch into the registration supervision.

III-F 4 Detection-Aware Fusion (Det2Fus)
blocks.zh: III-F 4 探测-智能聚合(Det2Fus)

blocks.en:
To explicitly inject object-level semantics into the fusion process, we further design Det2Fus , which allows detection to reshape the detector-oriented fusion representation before final inference.
Unlike simply attaching a detection loss to the fused output, Det2Fus first constructs an ROI-guided prior and uses it to rewrite the detector-side fusion representation.
The construction of the ROI masks M gt M_{\mathrm{gt}} , M d3 M_{\mathrm{d3}} , the mixed prior M mix M_{\mathrm{mix}} , and the task-driven detector representation F det td F_{\mathrm{det}}^{\mathrm{td}} has been introduced in Sec. III-E2 .
Here, we focus on how this detector-side semantic prior is further fed back to FusDM through task-driven fusion constraints.

Det2Fus 与简单地将检测损失附加在引信输出上不同,它首先构建了ROI导线,并使用它来重写探测器侧聚变表示.

在这里,我们侧重于如何通过任务驱动的聚变限制,进一步将这一探测器侧语义反馈回FusDM。

blocks.en: III-G Training Strategy and Nash-MTL-based Late-Stage Refinement

blocks.en:
TriDifNet is not trained with a single static
schedule from the beginning. Instead, we adopt a stage-wise
progressive training strategy to stabilize optimization across
registration, fusion, and detection. Specifically, the training
process consists of multiple stages. We first optimize the
registration branch while freezing the fusion and detection
branches, so that RegDM can establish a reliable geometric
alignment basis. Next, we optimize the coupled RegDM–FusDM
and RegDM–DetDM settings separately by freezing one branch
at a time, which allows the fusion and detection branches to
adapt to the registration-guided inputs under reduced
optimization interference. After that, all three branches are
jointly optimized in the full closed-loop setting, so that
Det2Reg, Det2Fus, and Fus2Reg can simultaneously
participate in the end-to-end interaction.

This design is motivated by the observation that the final

This inference pipeline consistently reflects the design principle of TriDifNet: geometry is first corrected by RegDM, cross-modal information is integrated by FusDM, and final task-level semantics are produced by DetDM through prediction-guided detection refinement.

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted on the KAIST Multispectral Pedestrian Benchmark [ 30 ] , which provides paired visible–thermal images for RGB–T pedestrian perception.
Following a cleaned annotation setting, heavily occluded, severely truncated, extremely small, and ambiguous pedestrian annotations are removed or ignored.
The remaining valid pedestrian-related annotations are merged into a single pedestrian class for training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是在KAIST多光谱行人基准[30]上进行的,该基准为RGB-T行人感知提供了对齐的可见-热图像.
在经过清理的注解设置后,严重占用,严重截断,极小,模糊不清的行人注解被删除或忽略.
剩余的有效行人相关说明被合并为单一行人班,用于培训和评价.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Baselines Used In The Experiments
blocks.zh: 表二:试验中使用的基准

blocks.en:
Considering the memory cost of joint registration, fusion, and detection training, we adopt patch-based processing instead of full-frame training.
Each visible–thermal pair is cropped into 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches with a stride of 128 128 , and at most 50 50 ground-truth boxes are retained for each patch.
The processed training patches are further split into training and validation subsets with a ratio of 0.8 0.8 .
For background-only patches with empty samples, only 20 % 20\% are retained independently within the training/validation and testing splits to avoid overwhelming the optimization.
For each retained patch, both reference-coordinate boxes and perturbed infrared-domain boxes are stored for branch-specific detection evaluation.
blocks.zh:
考虑到联合注册、核聚变和检测培训的内存成本,我们采用补丁处理,而不是全面培训。
每个可见的-热成对被收成256×256256\时的256个补丁,脚步128128,每个补丁最多保留50个地面真人盒.
已处理的培训补丁进一步分为培训和鉴定子集,比例为0.80.8.
对于带有空样本的仅背景补丁,在训练/验证和测试拆分中仅保留20%的20QQ,以避免压倒优化.
对于每个保留的补丁,都存储了参考坐标箱和扰动红外线域箱,用于分支特定检测评价.

blocks.en:
Since KAIST does not provide real fusion ground truth, we use the fusion results produced by LRRNet [ 33 ] on the original KAIST data as a pseudo teacher target for training FusDM.
The teacher output is used only to stabilize residual fusion learning and is not treated as exact fusion ground truth for final evaluation.
blocks.zh:
由于KAIST没有提供真正的聚变地面真相,我们使用LRRNet[33]在KAIST原始数据上得出的聚变结果作为FusDM训练的伪师目标.
教师输出只用于稳定剩余聚变学习,不作为准确的聚变地面真相进行最终评价.

blocks.en: To simulate weakly misaligned RGB-T perception, synthetic affine perturbations are applied to the infrared modality while the visible image is kept as the reference. In the current setting, the infrared patch is perturbed by an in-plane rotation up to 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} and a translation ratio of 0.05 0.05 , corresponding to a maximum translation of approximately 12.8 12.8 pixels along each axis for a 256 × 256 256\times 256 patch. This controlled setting focuses on weak affine misalignment rather than severe non-rigid deformation, and is used to evaluate whether RegDM can provide reliable geometric correction for the target RGB-T perception scenario.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟微弱的误联RGB-T感知,合成的芳香扰动被应用于红外模式,而可见的图像则作为参考. 在目前的设置中,红外补丁受到飞机内旋转的扰动,最高可达2××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××的翻译比为0.050.05,对应每个轴沿最大翻译为12.8 12.8像素,为256×时的补丁. 这种可控设置侧重于弱的afzine错位而非严重的非刚性变形,用于评价RegDM是否能够为目标RGB-T感知场景提供可靠的几何校正.

blocks.en:
We evaluate TriDifNet from three perspectives.
For registration, we report root mean squared error (RMSE), normalized cross-correlation / correlation coefficient (NCC/CC), and structural similarity (SSIM) [ 34 ] between the registered infrared image and the aligned infrared reference.
For fusion, we use weak-reference image-level measures, including CC and UIQI [ 35 ] , to evaluate structural consistency and cross-modal information preservation.
For detection, we report Precision, Recall, mAP 50 , and mAP 50:95 for the visible branch, the infrared or registered-infrared branch, and the fusion branch.
Since all valid pedestrian-related annotations are merged into a single pedestrian class, mAP 50:95 is computed in a single-class COCO-style [ 36 ] manner over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 with a step size of 0.05.
The annotation domain used for each detection branch follows the comparison setting summarized in Table I . The final fusion-side detection result serves as the primary evaluation of the complete network.
blocks.zh:
我们从三个角度评价TriDifNet。
关于登记,我们报告root的平均方差(RMSE),正常的交叉关系/关联系数(NCC/CC),以及已登记的红外线图像与对齐红外线参照之间的结构相似性(SSIM)[34]。
对于聚变,我们使用包括CC和UIQI[35]在内的弱参考图像级别措施来评价结构一致性和跨模式信息保存.
为了侦测,我们报告精度,回溯,mAP 50,和mAP 50:95 可见分支,红外或注册红外分支,以及聚变分支.
由于所有与行人有关的有效说明都合并为单一行人类别,因此mAP 50:95在IOU阈值上以单级COCO型[36]方式计算,从0.50到0.95,步数为0.05。
每个检测分支所用的注释域遵循表一概述的比较设置. 最后的聚变侧检测结果是对完整网络的主要评价。

blocks.en: IV-B Experimental Settings and Baselines
blocks.zh: 四-B 实验设置和基线

blocks.en:
TriDifNet is implemented in PyTorch and trained on a single NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti GPU with 16 GB memory.
All experiments are conducted with 256 × 256 256\times 256 input patches.
The model is trained under the stage-wise three-task optimization strategy introduced in Sec. III-G , with a batch size of 1 1 , 30,000 30{,}000 training iterations, and 500 500 diffusion timesteps.
RegDM, FusDM, and DetDM are optimized within the unified closed-loop training pipeline using branch-specific optimizers, with learning rates of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and 2.5 × 10 − 5 2.5\times 10^{-5} , respectively.
blocks.zh:
TriDifNet在PyTorch执行,并接受了单NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti GPU的训练,拥有16GB内存.
所有实验都使用256×256256\times256输入补丁进行.
该模型在Sec. III-G中引入的阶段性三任务优化策略下进行训练,批量规模为1 1,30,000{,}000次训练迭代,500个推广时间步.
RegDM,FusDM,DetDM在统一闭路训练管内采用分支专用优化器进行优化,学习率分别为2×10−4 2\times 10×4 10×4 10×4 10×4 10×4,2.5×10×5 2.5×10×5 5 ).

blocks.en:
At test time, the training-only auxiliary components are removed, and the deployed inference pipeline consists of RegDM, FusDM, and DetDM with ROI-guided re-inference.
For diffusion inference, RegDM and FusDM use DDIM sampling [ 37 ] with 25 25 steps.
For ROI-guided re-inference, the first-pass D3 confidence threshold is set to 0.10 0.10 to improve recall for ROI construction, whereas the final second-pass detection uses a confidence threshold of 0.30 0.30 for reporting Precision and Recall.
No ground-truth boxes are used for ROI construction during inference.
All FPS results are measured on the same platform with batch size 1 1 , excluding data loading and file I/O.
blocks.zh:
在测试时,只培训的辅助部件被移除,部署的推论管道包括RegDM,FusDM,以及使用ROI制导的重新推论的DetDM.
对于扩散推论,RegDM和FusDM使用DDIM采样[37],共25个步骤.
对于ROI制导的再推论,第一次通过D3置信阈值设定为0.100.10,以改善ROI建造的召回,而最后一次第二次通过检测则使用0.300.30置信阈值报告精度和召回.
在推论期间,没有使用地面真象盒来建造ROI。
所有FPS结果都在同一批号为11的平台上进行测量,不包括数据加载和文件I/O.

blocks.en:
To avoid ambiguity, the compared methods are grouped into registration, fusion, and system-level baselines, as summarized in Table II .
Registration baselines evaluate geometric correction under the same misaligned RGB-T input.
Fusion baselines evaluate image-level fusion behavior under aligned-input conditions.
System-level baselines evaluate the final pedestrian detection performance under complete RGB-T perception pipelines.
Since LRRNet [ 33 ] is used as the pseudo teacher for FusDM training, it is not included as a direct image-level fusion baseline, and its downstream influence is evaluated through S4 and S5.
For detector-based system baselines, most external pipelines use YOLO11s as the downstream detector, while S6 follows the original MetaFusion evaluation setup and uses YOLOv5s [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了避免模棱两可,比较方法分为登记、聚变和系统一级基线,见表二。
登记基线在同一错误的RGB-T输入下评价几何校正.
融合基线在对齐输入条件下评价图像级聚变行为.
系统层面基线在完整的RGB-T感知管道下评价最终行人检测性能.
由于LRRNet[33]被用作FusDM训练的伪师,因此它没有作为直接图像级聚变基线列入,它的下游影响通过S4和S5.
对于基于探测器的系统基线,大多数外部管道使用YOLO11作为下游探测器,而S6遵循了最初的MetaFusion评价设置,并使用YOLOv5s [11].

blocks.en: Different experiments follow different input settings. Registration comparisons start from the same misaligned RGB-T input and evaluate only the registered infrared output. Fusion comparisons are conducted under a unified aligned-input condition to isolate fusion behavior from registration errors. End-to-end comparisons start from the same misaligned RGB-T input and evaluate the final detection results with branch-specific annotations. Specifically, visible, registered-infrared, and fusion-side outputs are evaluated with reference-coordinate boxes, while unaligned-infrared detection is evaluated with perturbed infrared-domain boxes.
blocks.zh: 不同的实验遵循不同的输入设置. 注册比较从同样的错误的RGB-T输入开始,只评价注册的红外输出. 融合比较是在统一的对齐输入条件下进行的,以隔离聚变行为与注册错误. 端到端的比较从相同的错误对齐的RGB-T输入开始,用分支特定说明评价最终检测结果. 具体而言,用参考坐标箱评价可见的、已登记的红外线和聚变侧输出,而用扰动红外线域箱评价不相通红外线探测。

blocks.en: For fair comparison, all baseline methods are trained and evaluated under the same overall data setting used by TriDifNet. For methods with official implementations, we follow their released configurations whenever applicable, initialize them from the official pretrained weights, and fine-tune them on the current training data rather than training from scratch. For module-level baselines, registration methods are fine-tuned on the misaligned RGB-T training set, while fusion methods are fine-tuned on the aligned RGB-T training set according to Table I . Each single-task baseline is fine-tuned for 50 50 epochs and evaluated on the corresponding unified test set.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平的比较,所有基准方法都根据TriDifNet使用的总体数据设置来训练和评估。 对于正式实施的方法,只要适用,我们就遵循其发布的配置,从官方预先培训的权重中初始化,并从零开始对当前培训数据进行微调。 对于模块级基线,登记方法在RGB-T错配的训练集上进行微调,而聚变方法则在按照表一调整的RGB-T训练集上进行微调. 每个单任务基准对50个世纪进行微调,并在相应的统一测试集上进行评估.

blocks.en:
For system-level baselines with sequential components, each downstream component is fine-tuned on the training-set outputs produced by its upstream component for 50 50 epochs before being evaluated on the corresponding test-set outputs.
For the MulFS-CAP-based [ 3 ] baselines F3 and S7, we follow the official implementation and fine-tune it for 200 200 epochs using 500 500 randomly sampled training pairs and 100 100 validation pairs.
All baselines, including MulFS-CAP-based pipelines, are evaluated on the same unified test set.
blocks.zh:
对于具有相继组成部分的系统一级基线,每个下游组成部分都对其上游组成部分50个世纪的培训产出进行微调,然后对相应的测试产出进行评价。
对于基于MulFS-CAP的[3]基线F3和S7,我们遵循正式执行,并对200200个纪元进行微调,使用500500个随机抽样的训练对和100100个验证对.
所有基线,包括基于MulFS-CAP的输油管,都在同一统一测试集中进行评价。

blocks.en: IV-C Main Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: IV-C 主要数量 结果

blocks.en: We first compare RegDM with the registration baselines under the same misalignment setting. All methods take the same misaligned RGB-T pair as input and output a registered infrared image. Since the current benchmark focuses on controlled weak affine perturbations, this comparison is intended to evaluate whether RegDM can provide reliable geometric correction under the target weakly misaligned RGB-T setting, rather than to claim general superiority under severe non-rigid deformation scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将RegDM与同一错配设置下的登记基线进行比较. 所有方法都采用相同的误联RGB-T对作为输入并输出一个注册红外图像. 由于目前的基准侧重于可控的弱近缘扰动,因此这一比较旨在评价RegDM能否在目标弱错配的RGB-T设定下提供可靠的几何校正,而不是在严重的非刚性变形假想下声称一般优越.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table III , the proposed RegDM achieves the lowest RMSE (10.425901) and the highest SSIM (0.856359) among the compared registration methods, while maintaining competitive NCC/CC.
R3 obtains a slightly higher NCC/CC (0.835497), indicating that the image-level registration scores of different methods can be close under the controlled weak-misalignment setting.
These results suggest that RegDM provides stable geometric correction for the subsequent fusion and detection stages, rather than an overwhelming single-task registration advantage over all baselines.
The qualitative results in Fig. 4 further show that RegDM produces low-residual responses and coherent checkerboard alignment patterns.
The downstream contribution of RegDM is further evaluated in the end-to-end detection comparison and the system-level ablations, where RegDM is coupled with Det2Reg and Fus2Reg.
blocks.zh:
如表三所示,拟议的登记管理办法在比较登记方法中实现了最低登记制度(10.425901)和最高登记制度(0.856359),同时保持了NCC/CC的竞争。
R3获得略高的NCC/CC(0.835497),表示不同方法的图像级注册分数在受控弱错位设置下可以接近.
这些结果表明,RegDM为随后的聚变和检测阶段提供了稳定的几何校正,而不是在所有基线上压倒性的单任务登记优势.
图4的质量结果进一步显示,RegDM产生低残留响应和连贯的跳板对齐模式.
RegDM的下游贡献在端对端检测比较和系统层面的堆积中得到了进一步评价,其中RegDM与Det2Reg和Fus2Reg结合.

blocks.en:
We next compare FusDM with the fusion baselines under a unified aligned-input condition.
This setting isolates fusion behavior from registration errors and follows the corresponding setting in Table I .
Since KAIST does not provide real fusion ground truth and the LRRNet output is used only as a pseudo teacher during training, the following comparison reports weak-reference image-level indicators rather than treating teacher-referenced scores as the primary evidence.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将FusDM与核聚变基线进行比较, 在一个统一的对齐投入条件下。
此设置将聚变行为与注册错误隔离, 并遵循表一中的相应设置 。
由于KAIST没有提供真实的聚变地面真相,且LRRNet的输出在培训期间仅作为伪教师使用,以下比较报告参考图像水平指标薄弱,而不是将师资参考分数作为主要证据.

blocks.zh: 表三:登记结果的定量比较

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Qualitative comparison of registration results corresponding to Table III , including absolute-error heatmaps and checkerboard alignment visualizations.
blocks.zh: 费格。 4:对表三对应的登记结果进行定性比较,包括绝对异常热图和检查板对齐可视化.

blocks.zh: 表四:合并结果的定量比较

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Qualitative comparison of fusion results corresponding to Table IV . TriDifNet emphasizes target-aware infrared saliency while maintaining visible structural cues for downstream detection.
blocks.zh: 费格。 5:与表四相对应的聚变结果定性比较. TriDifNet强调目标感知红外线的显著性,同时保持可见的结构提示,用于下游探测.

blocks.en:
Table IV reports weak-reference image-level fusion scores under the aligned-input setting.
F3 and F2 achieve the best CC and UIQI, respectively, while FusDM obtains competitive but not leading teacher-referenced scores.
Since the KAIST benchmark lacks real fusion ground truth, these metrics are used only to characterize image-level fusion behavior rather than downstream perception utility.
Fig. 5 shows that FusDM preserves visible structural cues and enhances target-related infrared responses.
More detailed evidence for its task-level effectiveness is provided by the end-to-end detection comparison in Sec. IV-C and the cross-task ablations in Sec. IV-D .
blocks.zh:
表四报告在对齐输入设置下对映图像级聚变分数差.
F3和F2分别实现最佳CC和UIQI,而FusDM则获得竞争性但并非领先的师资参考分数.
由于KAIST基准缺乏真实的聚变地面真实性,这些度量标准只用于描述图像级聚变行为而非下游感知效用.
图5显示FusDM保留了可见的结构提示,并加强了目标相关红外响应.
通过Sec. IV-C的端对端检测比较和Sec. IV-D的交叉任务堆积提供了更详细的证据,说明其任务层面的有效性。

blocks.en:
The most important comparison is the end-to-end pedestrian detection performance.
All system-level baselines start from the same misaligned RGB-T input and are evaluated under the same detection benchmark.
This comparison directly verifies whether the proposed closed-loop Reg–Fus–Det optimization improves downstream perception compared with single-modality settings, sequential external pipelines, and partially coupled alternatives.
blocks.zh:
最重要的比较是端对端行人探测性能.
所有系统级基线都从相同的误联RGB-T输入开始,并在相同的检测基准下进行评估.
这一比较直接核实了拟议的封闭式放行Reg-Fus-Det优化是否与单一模式设置、顺序式外部管道和部分组合式替代方案相比提高了下游的认知。

blocks.en: TABLE V: End-To-End Pedestrian Detection Comparison
blocks.zh: 表五:行人端到端检测比较

blocks.en:
Table V reports the system-level detection results.
TriDifNet obtains the best scores on the three main detection metrics, i.e., 65.44% Recall, 57.55% mAP 50 , and 26.83% mAP 50:95 .
Compared with the strongest external system-level baseline S7, TriDifNet improves these three metrics by 16.99%, 13.89%, and 7.81%, respectively.
Although the visible-only baseline S1 obtains the highest precision, its recall and mAP remain limited, indicating that single-modality detection is insufficient under misaligned RGB-T inputs.
blocks.zh:
表五报告系统一级的检测结果。
TriDifNet在三大检测度量衡上获得最佳分数,即65.44%的回溯率,57.55%的mAP 50,26.83%的mAP 50:95.
与最强的外部系统一级基线S7相比,TriDifNet将这三项指标分别改进了16.99%、13.89%和7.81%。
虽然只可见的基线S1获得了最高的精度,但其召回和mAP仍然有限,表明单模式检测在RGB-T输入错配下是不够的.

blocks.en:
S3 shows a sharp degradation under the post-registration detection setting, with only 9.28% recall, 8.32% mAP 50 , and 3.12% mAP 50:95 .
Although PGMR obtains competitive image-level registration scores in Table III , its registered output may still contain object-level residual offsets with respect to the reference-domain detection annotations.
Such offsets can be amplified into localization errors and missed detections, leading to a clear decrease in recall and mAP.
This result shows that good single-task registration metrics do not necessarily guarantee detection-consistent alignment in a decoupled Reg → \rightarrow Det pipeline.
blocks.zh:
S3显示在登记后检测环境中出现急剧退化,只有9.28%被召回,8.32%为mAP 50,3.12%为mAP 50:95.
虽然PGMR在表三中获得了具有竞争力的图像级注册分数,但其注册产出仍可能包含与参考域检测说明相关的对象级剩余抵消.
这种抵消可以被放大为本地化错误和错失检测,导致召回和mAP明显减少.
这一结果表明,良好的单一任务登记指标不一定能保证在脱钩的Reg →\rightarrow Det管道中与检测一致的对齐。

blocks.en:
S4 also yields limited detection performance, with 25.22% recall and 22.90% mAP 50 .
Since LRRNet is applied without explicit registration in this setting, the fused image can suffer from misalignment-induced ghosting, double edges, and target deformation.
These artifacts degrade the detector input and further propagate to the final detection metrics.
S5 performs the fully external Reg → \rightarrow Fus → \rightarrow Det pipeline, but the sequential combination still suffers from the accumulation of registration and fusion errors.
For the MetaFusion-based setting S6, we follow its original evaluation setup with YOLOv5s, so part of the performance difference may also come from the different detector configuration.
blocks.zh:
S4的检测性能也有限,召回率为25.22%,mAP为22.90%50.
由于LRRNet的应用没有在此设置中明确注册,因此被引信的图像可能遭受错配引起的鬼魂,双边,以及目标变形.
这些文物降解了探测器的输入,并进一步传播到最后的探测指标中.
S5 完全执行外部 Reg ~\右旋 Fus → 右旋Det输油管,但顺序组合仍然受到注册和聚变错误的积累的影响.
对于基于MetaFusion的设置S6,我们跟随其最初的评价设置使用YOLOv5s,因此部分性能差异也可能来自不同的探测器配置.

blocks.en:
Overall, the large gains in recall and mAP indicate that TriDifNet reduces missed detections and achieves a better detection trade-off under misaligned RGB-T inputs.
These results support the effectiveness of closed-loop optimization among registration, fusion, and detection over sequential or partially coupled pipelines.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,在召回和mAP方面的巨大收益表明,TriDifNet减少了错失的检测,在RGB-T输入错位下实现了更好的检测权衡.
这些结果支持在登记、核聚变和在相继或部分相连的管道上检测闭路优化的有效性。

blocks.en:
Fig. further provides qualitative evidence for the end-to-end comparison.
Compared with the system-level baselines, TriDifNet produces more complete and better localized pedestrian predictions under misaligned RGB-T inputs.
This advantage is most evident in Cases 4 and 5, where several baselines suffer from missed detections under weak visible cues and low-contrast infrared responses, whereas TriDifNet still retains stable target predictions.
The qualitative comparison is consistent with the quantitative gains reported in Table V .
blocks.zh:
图.进一步提供了定性证据,用于端对端比较.
与系统层面的基线相比,TriDifNet在RGB-T输入错位下,生成更加完整和更好的本地化行人预测.
在案例4和案例5中,这一优势最为明显,在案例4和案例5中,若干基线在可见光度低的提示和低连续红外响应下被探测不到,而TriDifNet仍然保留着稳定的目标预测。
质量比较与表五所报告的数量收益一致。

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-D 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct system-level ablations to evaluate the contribution of RegDM and FusDM to RGB-T pedestrian perception.
DetDM is retained in all variants, and each variant is trained under the same training schedule before testing.
When both RegDM and FusDM are removed, detection is performed on the unaligned infrared input; when FusDM is removed, detection is performed on the registered infrared image; otherwise, detection is performed on the fusion-oriented representation.
blocks.zh:
我们进行系统层面的清扫,以评估RegDM和FusDM对RGB-T行人感知的贡献.
DetDM在所有变体中都保留,每个变体在测试前在相同的训练时间表下接受训练.
当RegDM和FusDM都被移除时,在不对齐的红外输入上进行检测;当FusDM被移除时,在注册的红外图像上进行检测;否则,在聚变导向的表示上进行检测.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table VI , removing RegDM and FusDM gives limited detection performance, with 37.90% mAP 50 and 13.71% mAP 50:95 .
Using FusDM alone improves mAP 50 from 37.90% to 44.67% and mAP 50:95 from 13.71% to 19.13%, indicating that cross-modal fusion provides useful perception cues even under misalignment.
Using RegDM alone produces a smaller improvement, increasing mAP 50 from 37.90% to 39.04% and mAP 50:95 from 13.71% to 14.07%.
This suggests that registration alone is insufficient for the final perception task when cross-modal fusion is absent.
The full TriDifNet achieves the best detection results, reaching 65.44% recall, 57.55% mAP 50 , and 26.83% mAP 50:95 .
The large performance gap between the full TriDifNet and the single-module variants indicates that RegDM and FusDM are more effective when jointly optimized within the full TriDifNet model.
blocks.zh:
如表六所示,删除RegDM和FusDM的检测性能有限,分别为37.90%的mAP 50和13.71%的mAP 50:95.
单使用FusDM就可以改善mAP 50,从37.90%提高到44.67%,mAP 50:95,从13.71%提高到19.13%,这表明跨模式聚变即使在错位下也能提供有用的感知提示.
仅使用RegDM就可以产生较小的改进,将mAP 50从37.90%增加到39.04%,mAP 50:95从13.71%增加到14.07%.
这表明,在没有跨模式聚变的情况下,仅登记不足以完成最后的认知任务。
整个TriDifNet的检测结果最好,达到65.44%的回溯率,57.55%的mAP 50,26.83%的mAP 50:95.
完整TriDifNet和单模块变体之间的较大性能差距表明,RegDM和FusDM在完整TriDifNet模型内联合优化时效果更好.

blocks.en:
Table VI also reports the inference efficiency of different variants.
The lower FPS of the full TriDifNet is mainly associated with the additional iterative computation introduced by diffusion-based registration, diffusion-based fusion, and ROI-guided re-inference.
This efficiency cost is a common limitation of diffusion-based registration–fusion methods [ 2 ] .
In this work, the main focus is to evaluate three-task closed-loop optimization under misaligned RGB-T inputs.
Improving the real-time efficiency of the diffusion-based inference pipeline will be investigated in future work.
blocks.zh:
表六还报告了不同变体的推论效率.
整个TriDifNet的下层FPS主要与基于扩散的注册,基于扩散的聚变以及ROI制导的重推引入的额外迭代计算有关.
这种效率成本是对基于扩散的登记-聚变方法的共同限制[2]。
在这项工作中,主要重点是在错误的RGB-T输入下评价三任务闭路优化.
今后的工作将调查提高传播推论管道的实时效率。

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the cross-task feedback paths and the key internal mechanisms in Table VII .
Compared with the full TriDifNet, removing Det2Reg degrades both registration and detection, increasing RMSE from 10.4259 to 10.8720 and reducing mAP 50 from 57.55% to 54.11%.
This indicates that the frozen infrared-domain detector provides useful object-level semantic guidance for registration.
Removing Fus2Reg causes the largest registration degradation among the feedback-path variants, with RMSE increasing to 11.0282 and SSIM decreasing to 0.8426, suggesting that fusion-to-registration structural feedback contributes to geometric consistency.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评估表七中的跨任务反馈路径和关键内部机制。
与完整的TriDifNet相比,去除Det2Reg可同时降解注册和检测,RMSE从10.4259增加到10.8720,mAP50从57.55%减少到54.11%.
这表明冷冻红外线域探测器为注册提供了有用的物体级语义指导.
清除Fus2Reg会导致反馈路径变体中最大的登记退化,RMSE增加至11.0282,SSIM减少至0.8426,这表明聚变到登记的结构反馈有助于几何一致性.

blocks.en:
The detection-aware fusion pathway has the most direct influence on final perception.
Without Det2Fus, mAP 50 and mAP 50:95 decrease from 57.55% and 26.83% to 42.03% and 18.70%, respectively.
When ROI-IR Injection is further disabled, the performance further drops to 36.60% and 14.54%.
The variants without Det2Fus or ROI-IR Injection obtain higher fusion scores in terms of CC and UIQI, but these higher image-level scores are accompanied by a clear decline in detection performance.
This trend suggests that removing detection-oriented feedback shifts the fusion branch toward weak-reference image-level similarity, rather than target-aware representation learning.
Therefore, weak-reference fusion metrics do not necessarily reflect downstream task utility in the misaligned RGB-T detection setting.
The performance drops caused by removing Det2Fus and ROI-IR Injection support the importance of fusion–detection coupling and ROI-level infrared injection for constructing a task-discriminative fusion representation.
blocks.zh:
探测-意识聚变途径对最终感知影响最大.
没有Det2Fus,mAP 50和mAP 50:95分别从57.55%和26.83%下降到42.03%和18.70%.
当ROI-IR注射被进一步禁用时,性能进一步下降到36.60%和14.54%.
没有Det2Fus或ROI-IR注射的变体在CC和UIQI方面获得更高的聚变分数,但这些更高的图像级分数伴随着检测性能的明显下降.
这一趋势表明,去除面向检测的反馈会让聚变分支转向弱参考图像层次的相似性,而不是目标意识的表示性学习.
因此,弱参考聚变指标在RGB-T错位检测设置中不一定反映下游任务效用.
拆除Det2Fus和ROI-IR注射导致的性能下降支持了聚变-检测耦合和ROI级红外注射对于构建任务差异化聚变代表的重要性.

blocks.en:
Removing Nash-MTL also reduces mAP 50 from 57.55% to 55.32%, indicating the benefit of late-stage three-branch optimization balancing among registration, fusion, and detection.
Overall, the full TriDifNet achieves the best registration and detection results, supporting the complementary effects of the proposed closed-loop feedback paths and internal refinement mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
移除Nash-MTL也会将mAP 50从57.55%降至55.32%,表明在登记、核聚变和检测之间实现三分支晚期优化的好处。
总体而言,整个TriDifNet取得了最好的登记和检测结果,支持了拟议的闭路反馈路径和内部完善机制的互补作用。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose TriDifNet, a unified diffusion-based network for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception.
By optimizing registration, fusion, and detection in a closed loop, TriDifNet reduces sequential error propagation and enables geometric alignment, cross-modal fusion, and task-level semantics to reinforce each other.
Experiments on the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark show that TriDifNet provides reliable registration and task-oriented fusion, while achieving clear improvements in end-to-end pedestrian detection over single-modality, sequential, and partially coupled baselines.
Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of the cross-task feedback paths, ROI-guided infrared injection, and late-stage multi-task balancing.
Future work will focus on improving inference efficiency and extending the network to broader RGB-T perception scenarios.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出TriDifNet,一个用于错误的RGB-T行人感知的统一传播网络.
通过在闭环中优化注册、核聚变和检测,TriDifNet减少了相继错误传播,并使几何对齐、跨模式核聚变和任务层次的语义相互强化。
关于KAIST多谱行人基准的实验表明,TriDifNet提供了可靠的登记和面向任务的聚变,同时在端到端行人检测方面,比单模式、顺序和部分组合基线有了明显的改进。
校准研究进一步支持跨任务反馈路径,ROI制导红外注射,以及后期多任务平衡的有效性.
今后的工作将侧重于提高推论效率,并将网络扩大到更广泛的RGB-T感知情景。
